purpose: Stationary NPC skins for Boran, Ada and merchant Miro

format.poses: one south-facing idle pose per image

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production stationary NPC sprite for a browser pixel-art MMORPG, shown in-game at roughly40x60 pixels. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the provided character sheet's compact chibi proportions, elevated three-quarter RPG viewpoint, chunky sharp pixel clusters, strong dark outlines, clustered highlights and limited warm medieval fantasy palette. Generate ONE original NPC named Boran: an elderly male village guide, short gray hair, full trimmed gray beard, forest-brown traveling cloak over olive tunic, belt, dark trousers and leather boots. A small rolled map tucked in belt communicates his role. Warm approachable face. Fully clothed. Pose facing SOUTH/front toward the viewer, full body, arms relaxed, feet planted in neutral idle stance. ONE complete character ONLY, centered in a portrait canvas1024x1536 with generous clear transparent padding; feet around90% canvas height, head around10%. Actual ALPHA TRANSPARENCY everywhere outside the character. No scenery, backdrop, floor, shadow, checkerboard, text, letters, labels, frames, border, grid, extra poses or sprite sheet. Pixel art sprite, hard square pixel edges, no blur, no painterly brushwork, no photorealism. Keep limbs and facial details readable at tiny game scale. Match reference costume rendering and body/head proportions but distinct adult elder identity. Do not reproduce the reference blue traveler.
